description:
Are the Kids OK? Now available in Spanish!
Please share widely among your Spanish-speaking friends and communities!Show more ¿Están bien los niños?
Este es un mensaje importante acerca de la seguridad de las vacunas contra el Covid-19 en los niños. Por favor comparte este mensaje con tus familiares, amigos y vecinos de habla hispana.
Are the Kids OK?
How did Pfizer recruit kids for its Covid-19 vaccine trial? Why was a New York hospital running an ad to bring in children? Watch this video and find out.
Join us for the VSRF Weekly Update
with Founder Steve Kirsch & Executive Director, Louisa Clary
Every Thursday 7 PM Eastern / 4 PM Pacific
Register at https://www.VacSafety.org
We are grateful for your support. You can donate to the VSRF here:
https://www.vacsafety.org/donate
Or to text-to-donate, text LIBERTY to 53555
